name: Beacon-4 Fission Plant
blurb: 22 kWe compact fission plant. Derived from Kilopower-class surface reactors, scaled up for shipboard use.

name: Fold-out Solar Wing
blurb: Supplementary array. Useful in the inner system, dead weight past the Belt. Must be stowed before any burn.

name: Battery Bank
blurb: 200 kWh at 350 Wh/kg. The margin between a quiet watch and a dark one.

name: CO2 Scrubber
blurb: Amine-bed scrubber, ISS CDRA lineage. Removes roughly 1 kg of CO2 per crew per day.

name: O2 Electrolysis Unit
blurb: Splits reclaimed water for breathing oxygen. The single largest steady draw on the ship.

name: Water Recycler
blurb: 98% closure. Every point below that is mass you have to carry.

name: Hydroponics Lamps
blurb: Grow lights for the rack. Food, a little oxygen, and the only green anyone sees for months.

name: Thermal Loop & Radiators
blurb: Pumps for the radiator loop. Everything the ship does becomes heat, and heat has to go somewhere.

name: Navigation & Flight Computers
blurb: Astrogation solver and flight control. Off means flying blind.

name: Comms Array
blurb: High-gain dish. Your only link to the Local, and it travels no faster than light.

name: Habitation Systems
blurb: Lighting, galley, water heating, and the exercise rig that keeps bone density off the medic's list.

name: NTR Preheat
blurb: Brings the nuclear thermal cluster to readiness. Enormous draw, and you cannot burn without it.
